note: Feel-first conversions. Jess describes the intended feel per move; agent maps to schema values. One move at a time. Source of truth for the #2 importer.

tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.feel: Melee cone swing in front of the character, quick jab. Static hitbox anchored to caster, aimed at nearest. Hits everything in the wedge once, with knockback.
tackle.flavor_text: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

swords-dance.name: Swords Dance
swords-dance.feel: Self-cast buff. Raises atk by 2 stage(s), team-wide per the settled scope rule. No hitbox, no target. cd 8 / dur 8 are hand-set (overrides layer in #2).
swords-dance.flavor_text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

agility.name: Agility
agility.feel: Self-cast buff. Raises spd by 2 stage(s), team-wide per the settled scope rule. No hitbox, no target. cd 8 / dur 8 are hand-set (overrides layer in #2).
agility.flavor_text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

harden.name: Harden
harden.feel: Self-cast buff. Raises def by 1 stage(s), team-wide per the settled scope rule. No hitbox, no target. cd 8 / dur 8 are hand-set (overrides layer in #2).
harden.flavor_text: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.

water-gun.name: Water Gun
water-gun.feel: Single water projectile fired in the aim direction, slight spread. Pierces 1 enemy (a deliberate difference from Ember's pierce 0). Damage only, no status. Same projectile template as Ember otherwise.
water-gun.flavor_text: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

ember.name: Ember
ember.feel: Single fire projectile in the aim direction, slight spread. Pierce 0 (dies on first enemy, canonical). 10% burn rider on hit. The canonical projectile template.
ember.flavor_text: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

hydro-pump.name: Hydro Pump
hydro-pump.feel: Straight water beam aimed at nearest. Unlimited pierce, hits everyone in the beam once. Static (no travel), lives 0.5s.
hydro-pump.flavor_text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

vine-whip.name: Vine Whip
vine-whip.feel: Melee cone in front, grass version of Tackle. Static hitbox, aims at nearest, slightly longer reach (radRadius 68) and tighter arc (1.3) than Tackle. Knockback 60.
vine-whip.flavor_text: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

aqua-ring.name: Aqua Ring
aqua-ring.feel: Persistent self-heal aura (slice 5a, MOVE-INTENT aqua-ring 2026-10-31): while Aqua Ring is the active move and the caster is not stunned it heals 1/16 max HP every 2 s, the mainline 1/16 per turn on the fork's 2 s turn (3.125% max HP/s). A slot swap, stun or faint ends it. Shapeless like Toxic (anchor caster, targeting none, motion static), no cooldown, no duration. SELF scope (a heal, not a team stat).
aqua-ring.flavor_text: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

razor-leaf.name: Razor Leaf
razor-leaf.feel: Two leaves thrown in a boomerang (motion returns), spread 0.5 between them. CHANGE: pierce UNLIMITED (was 0) so each leaf cuts through the whole crowd, striking on BOTH the outward and return legs (returnHits outAndBack). Heightened crit is the flavor; modeled as damage (crit handling TBD per the no-move-crit lean).
razor-leaf.flavor_text: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokemon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

giga-drain.name: Giga Drain
giga-drain.feel: Single grass projectile, pierce 0. Drains: heals the caster for half the damage dealt (heal from:dealt fraction 0.5). cardLocked on count+pierce so upgrade cards can't multiply or pierce it (preserves the fork's fixed:[count,pierce]).
giga-drain.flavor_text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

body-slam.name: Body Slam
body-slam.feel: Extra-wide Tackle (widest melee arc, 2.2) with shorter reach (46). 30% paralysis, high knockback (140). Static cone, aims at nearest.
body-slam.flavor_text: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

poison-sting.name: Poison Sting
poison-sting.feel: Tiny (radRadius 4), near-zero spread (0.08), very fast (moveSpeed 420) projectile. 30% poison. A rapid dart.
poison-sting.flavor_text: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

bug-bite.name: Bug Bite
bug-bite.feel: Tackle but narrower (arc 1.6), shorter (radRadius 44), and faster. 'Faster' is the cooldown (fork cd 0.42), which lives in the overrides layer (#2); hitbox geometry is the narrower+shorter cone. Knockback 40. Berry steal IS kept: a conditional-damage special, if the struck enemy is carrying a berry/consumable the hit deals double damage and consumes it. No survivor hold-item system yet, so this is a deferred hook for the #2 importer to wire (or stub) against whatever drop/holdable model exists.
bug-bite.flavor_text: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

payload.deferred: no holdable/berry system in local build yet; #2 wires or stubs

rock-throw.name: Rock Throw
rock-throw.feel: Rock version of Ember: single chunky projectile (radRadius 9), pierce 0, but with a knockback rider (90) instead of a status. Slower (moveSpeed 260), heavier feel.
rock-throw.flavor_text: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

ice-beam.name: Ice Beam
ice-beam.feel: Longer, narrower Hydro Pump (linLength 290 vs 250, linWidth 20 vs 30). UNLIMITED pierce, hits everyone in the beam. 10% freeze + spd -1 rider (icy chill as a stat debuff, side foe, scope individual; it climbs -1 per Gate on an enemy it keeps hitting, COMBAT-RULES "Stat stages"). Static, nearest.
ice-beam.flavor_text: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

karate-chop.name: Karate Chop
karate-chop.feel: Normal-type Tackle, focused narrow chop (arc 1.2, narrowest melee) with higher knockback (110 vs Tackle's 90). Static cone, aims at nearest. 'Increased crit' flavor dropped (no-move-crit lean). Type kept normal per Jess. NOTE: seed's flavor_text was a 'this move can't be used' error string, blanked.

aura-sphere.name: Aura Sphere
aura-sphere.feel: CHANGED from single homing orb to a curving slow burst: 6 orbs fired full-circle (spread 6.2832), very slow (moveSpeed 120), each following a gentle curve path (path.curve 1.5 rad/s) so they spiral outward. Homing (turnRate 4) DROPPED, the curve defines the motion now, not target-seeking. 'Never misses' identity is gone with the homing (deliberate tradeoff for the burst feel).
aura-sphere.flavor_text: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

lick.name: Lick
lick.feel: Ghost Tackle, super narrow (arc 0.8) but longer reach (radRadius 64 vs Tackle's 48) to compensate for the 30% paralysis. Static cone, aims at nearest.
lick.flavor_text: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

shadow-ball.name: Shadow Ball
shadow-ball.feel: Ghost Ember: single projectile, pierce 1 initially (down from seed's 2), keeps the Sp. Def-down debuff. Compensation for the debuff = shorter lifetime (endOn 1.2 vs seed 1.6) AND longer cooldown (cd lives in the overrides file, #2). CORRECTED: debuff stat is spDef (Special Defense), matching the fork description; the seed had wrongly carried spd (speed).
shadow-ball.flavor_text: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

dragon-rage.name: Dragon Rage
dragon-rage.feel: Hydro Pump dimensions (linLength 250, linWidth 30, matched exactly per Jess), UNLIMITED pierce, static beam aimed at nearest. But deals a FLAT 40 damage ignoring the type chart AND defenses, modeled as a fixed-damage special, not the normal damage formula. NOTE: seed's flavor_text was a 'this move can't be used' error string, blanked.

dragon-dance.name: Dragon Dance
dragon-dance.feel: Self-cast buff raising BOTH Attack and Speed by 1 stage, team-wide (settled scope rule). Compensation for the double buff = shorter duration (4s vs the normal 8s). Seed had dropped the speed stage; both restored here. cd 8 hand-set (overrides layer, #2).
dragon-dance.flavor_text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

metal-claw.name: Metal Claw
metal-claw.feel: Steel cone melee (arc 1.6, reach 50) with an Attack buff rider (atk +1, team scope per the buff rule) and knockback 60. Static, aims at nearest. The atk buff on-hit is the move's identity.
metal-claw.flavor_text: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.

flash-cannon.name: Flash Cannon
flash-cannon.feel: Steel Hydro Pump: linear beam (220x30), UNLIMITED pierce, static, nearest, with a Sp. Def-down debuff rider. CORRECTED to spDef to match its 'lower Sp. Def' description, consistent with the Shadow Ball fix; the seed had wrongly carried spd (speed).
flash-cannon.flavor_text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

bite.name: Bite
bite.feel: Bug Bite's cone shape (static melee, arc 1.5, reach 46) but NO berry special, plus a knockback (70) and a 30% flinch. Flinch restored from fork data (flinch 30); seed had dropped it. Static, aims at nearest. NOTE: type fixed to dark (seed wrongly carried normal; Bite is a dark move).
bite.flavor_text: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.feel: Ground Razor Leaf: 2 bones thrown as a boomerang (motion returns, spread 0.5), UNLIMITED pierce, striking on BOTH legs (returnHits outAndBack), matching Razor Leaf. Count raised 1->2 (seed had 1) to be the 2-projectile 'ground Razor Leaf'. Knockback 40 directional (along each bone's travel vector, not radial from caster).
bonemerang.flavor_text: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

psycho-cut.name: Psycho Cut
psycho-cut.feel: CHANGED from boomerang to a melee cone (Tackle dims: arc 1.7, reach 48). +15% crit, kept as a real effect this time (flat additive critChance per the settled crit mechanic), not dropped like Razor Leaf/Karate Chop, because Jess wants the crit identity and the mechanic exists in combat.js. Static, aims at nearest.
psycho-cut.flavor_text: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

quick-attack.name: Quick Attack
quick-attack.feel: Swept dash: the caster lunges at blinding speed to the nearest enemy and back (repositionMode swept, returnToOrigin true), striking on BOTH legs (returnHits outAndBack). Single-target lunge, pierce 0. dashMult 10 (sweeps at 10x the caster's final move speed; duration derived from distance/speed, not time-pinned). 0.3s i-frames cover the traversal so lunging through a crowd is safe. Priority 1 in source (always goes first); that is a turn-based fact with no real-time analogue, noted not modeled.
quick-attack.flavor_text: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.feel: Sustained tracking cone. Static wedge anchored to caster (radArc 0.9, reach 250), aimed at nearest, that SWIVELS to follow the nearest enemy at aimTrack 1.4 rad/s (static shape, so aimTrack not turnRate). Stays out 1.0s per cast and re-damages anything standing in it every 0.2s (hitPolicy interval, rehit 0.2). 10% burn rider on foe. A firehose you sweep across the crowd, not a projectile.
flamethrower.flavor_text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

fire-spin.name: Fire Spin
fire-spin.feel: 3-count orbit of fire around the caster at medium spin (angularSpeed 3.0, orbitRadius 90). Persistent while selected (endOn notActive). Re-damages every 0.4s (hitPolicy interval, rehit 0.4). 100% burn (the fierce vortex that scorches anything caught) plus a trap rider (held in the fire). pierce UNLIMITED (orbs never die on contact). Source is the inescapable 4-5 turn vortex; mapped to a sustained orbit, not a projectile.
fire-spin.flavor_text: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

heat-wave.name: Heat Wave
heat-wave.feel: Wave (Jess 2026-11-02): a band 16 px deep across the aim, 60 px wide, that travels 300 px/s at the nearest foe and widens with distance (growSpeed 0.667 px per px, max 260), so it is narrow near the user and wide far out. Ends at 1 s (about 300 px), a wall or off screen. Passes through every foe, each hit once (oncePerInstance). 10% burn. Was a full ring growing to 250 px.
heat-wave.flavor_text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave them with a burn.

leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
leaf-storm.feel: 4-projectile fast orbit (angularSpeed 5.0, orbitRadius 95) with a LOW rehit (0.25) for high throughput. The density is the payoff that offsets the harsh caster debuff: spAtk -2 on SELF after cast (the recoil). Persistent while selected. pierce UNLIMITED. High power (130) + fast rehit makes it a glass-cannon lane: huge DPS now, weaker specials after.
leaf-storm.flavor_text: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.feel: Double-take pulse nova. An emitter anchored to caster fires TWO expanding rings 0.2s apart; each emitted ring is world-anchored so it blooms from the spot it spawned (shockwave feel, not a ring that follows you). Each ring grows 0->110px in 0.4s (growSpeed 275 px/s; Jess 2026-10-31, slice 6: half the old 220 px). 30% paralysis on BOTH pulses (each ring carries the rider). Models the 'strikes everything around it' flare as two beats.
discharge.flavor_text: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.feel: Smite + chain. Instant strike on the nearest enemy (anchor target, motion static, endOn time 0), then arcs to 4 more (chainHops 4, hopRange 140). Initial hit is the heavy one (full power 90); each chain hit deals 33% of it (chainDamageFraction 0.33). cardLock on count so upgrade cards can NEVER add a second initial bolt, they can only grow chainHops (per Jess). 10% paralysis rider. Same smite idiom as Thunder Shock, scaled up with a bigger chain.
thunderbolt.flavor_text: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

payload.note: per-hop reduction: hop k deals x(1 - 0.33)^k of its own full hit, applied last (slice 4b S7, S10)

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.feel: CHANGED from the earlier static per-time grow to a slow TRAVELING tracked arc. A wedge that starts small (radArc 0.5) and widens to a medium ~115deg arc (radArc 2.0) as it drifts out slowly (moveSpeed 80), homing on the nearest enemy (turnRate). pierce omitted (default UNLIMITED: passes through everything it touches, each enemy hit once). 10% spDef-down rider on hit. The grow is on radArc (the wedge opening), not radRadius.
psychic.flavor_text: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

mud-shot.name: Mud Shot
mud-shot.feel: 6-count full-circle burst: 6 mud blobs fired at once, evenly spread around the caster (spread 6.2832), fast (moveSpeed 300), pierce 0 (each dies on first hit). 100% speed-down on hit (stat spd -1 foe, source stat_chance 100). A point-blank shotgun ring, not a single aimed blob (the burst conversion Jess locked).
mud-shot.flavor_text: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

gust.name: Gust
gust.feel: D-GUST (Jess 2026-10-30): fires 3 projectiles AT ONCE in an even 0.5 rad fan (one emission, child count 3; was a sequential emit every 0.08s with an inert per-shot spread), fast travel (moveSpeed 380) and knockback. A quick burst-fire of wind gusts. Each shot is a single fast projectile with a slight aim spread so the three don't stack perfectly.
gust.flavor_text: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

hyper-voice.name: Hyper Voice
hyper-voice.feel: Super-large nova. Full-circle ring (radArc 6.2832) whose edge expands 0->380px (biggest nova yet) in 0.5s (growSpeed 760 px/s, per time). Each enemy hit once as the edge crosses it (oncePerInstance). Damage only, no rider. A huge resounding shout that clears a wide ring around the caster.
hyper-voice.flavor_text: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.feel: Fast-ticking poison trail laid along the caster's path. Modeled as emit (the schema's trail primitive): an emitter drops short-lived world-anchored poison patches as the caster moves, tuned dense (every 0.1s) so it reads as a continuous ribbon rather than discrete circles. Status move (no direct damage); each patch applies poison fast. The badly-poison flavor maps to a plain poison ailment here (worsening DoT is a #2 resolver concern if we want it). NOTE: Jess wanted a true continuous ribbon; schema has no ribbon primitive, so emit-patches is the stand-in (acceptable per Jess, not flagged as a gap).
toxic.flavor_text: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.feel: Medium nova. Full-circle ring (radArc 6.2832) whose edge expands 0->200px in 0.4s (growSpeed 500 px/s, per time). Each enemy hit once as the edge crosses it (oncePerInstance). 100% speed-down on hit (stat spd -1 foe, source stat_chance 100). A ground-stomp shockwave; smaller than Heat Wave/Hyper Voice.
bulldoze.flavor_text: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

string-shot.name: String Shot
string-shot.feel: Slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): two silk strands one after another on the aim line, about 35 px apart (Fairy Wind's emitter pattern: a still emitter at the caster fires a strand at once, then a second 0.11 s later; 0.11 s x 320 px/s = 35 px). Status move (no direct damage). Each strand that hits applies Speed -2 (the second refreshes it under SS4) plus a trap hold. pierce 0. The bind-and-slow setup move.
string-shot.flavor_text: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

bug-buzz.name: Bug Buzz
bug-buzz.feel: Continuous damaging aura around the caster, persistent while selected (endOn notActive), radius 120. DAMAGE re-ticks every 0.5s (hitPolicy interval, rehit 0.5). The spDef-down rider lands on one tracker per enemy: the 0.5s ticks refresh it, and it climbs -1 per 6 s Gate while the enemy stays in the aura (COMBAT-RULES "Stat stages", MOVE-INTENT bug-buzz 2026-10-30). Models the steady damaging sound wave as a hum that chips HP continuously and wears Sp. Def down over time.
bug-buzz.flavor_text: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
rock-slide.feel: Meteor drop. World-anchored boulders fall on a target area after a 0.4s telegraphed wind-up (delay 0.4, the warning shadow before impact). Hits once on landing (oncePerInstance). 30% flinch (source). The meteor idiom: delay + world anchor + the impact is the hit, not a travel.
rock-slide.flavor_text: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

powder-snow.name: Powder Snow
powder-snow.feel: CHANGED from a spread snow-shot to a melee cone (Tackle dims: arc 1.7, reach 48), static, aims at nearest. 10% freeze rider (source). An ice jab in front. Conversion to melee is an intentional behavior change the harness should flag.
powder-snow.flavor_text: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also leave opposing Pokémon frozen.

fairy-wind.name: Fairy Wind
fairy-wind.feel: Slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): loop-de-loops travelling out. Like Gust, 3 projectiles in rapid succession (emit every 0.08s), zero spread, but each shot rides path.loop (combat-architecture D38): the loop is centred on a base point that drifts straight along the aim at 90 px/s, radius 70 px, 0.6667 loops per s, so the first loop goes round the caster and the shot makes 2 full loops in its 3 s flight, peaking about 280 px out. It starts at the top of its loop, one radius across from the caster. Top speed about 383 px/s. The 3 shots ride the same path and chase each other round it. Fairy, no rider. Was a 2 rad/s curve, which only bent the shot.
fairy-wind.flavor_text: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

dazzling-gleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzling-gleam.feel: Fast 180deg nova (radArc 3.1416, a half-circle flash in front). Snappy: edge expands 0->130px in 0.2s (growSpeed 650, per time). Each enemy hit once (oncePerInstance). cardLock on radArc so upgrade cards can NEVER widen the half-circle (per Jess), they can still grow radRadius. No rider, pure burst damage. Matches the earlier short-no-track correction.
dazzling-gleam.flavor_text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

dark-pulse.name: Dark Pulse
dark-pulse.feel: Dark nova. Full-circle ring (radArc 6.2832) whose edge expands 0->200px in 0.4s (growSpeed 500, per time). Each enemy hit once as the edge crosses it (oncePerInstance). 20% flinch (source). A ring of ill-intent aura bursting outward.
dark-pulse.flavor_text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

night-shade.name: Night Shade
night-shade.feel: Short-medium damaging aura around the caster (radius 120), persistent while selected (endOn notActive). Re-ticks every 0.5s (hitPolicy interval, rehit 0.5). Damage is FIXED to the active Pokemon's level (not the normal power formula): a special levelDamage handler, so power stays null. A creeping ghost mirage that gnaws everything nearby for level-scaled chip damage.
night-shade.flavor_text: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

payload.note: damage == active Pokemon's level, not the normal power formula; needs #2 resolver handler or stub

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.feel: Trap-field mine. World-anchored spikes laid on the ground with UNLIMITED lifetime (no timeout), waiting until an enemy steps on them (trigger contact). On trigger: 100% trap. Persist until triggered (the only terminator is the contact detonation). Status move, no direct damage. Matches the locked Spikes trap-field decision.
spikes.flavor_text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

payload.note: mine detonates on contact (unlimited lifetime until triggered); trigger:contact is the mine proximity rule per schema, needs #2 resolver support

toxic-spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxic-spikes.feel: Timed mine that bursts into a small poison nova when it ends (Jess 2026-10-31, slice 6: one burst per mine, a death effect, not a pulse every 0.25 s). World-anchored at the caster's feet, 3 s lifetime (endOn time 3), then emits once on termination a 100 px nova growing 400 px/s for 0.25 s that applies 100% poison. Unlike Spikes (unlimited-until-stepped-on trap), this one is a timed bomb: lay it, 3 s later it bursts. Status move, the effect is the poison nova, not direct contact.
toxic-spikes.flavor_text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

hail.name: Hail
hail.feel: Weather-state move (shapeless self-cast). Overrides the ambient weather to Snow for its duration (special setWeather handler, weather snow). No hitbox, no target, no shape. A player-cast weather override per the schema's shapeless state-change pattern. Duration hand-set at #2 (overrides layer); the described record carries the handler + weather kind, not the cd.
hail.flavor_text: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

payload.note: overrides ambient weather to Snow; duration hand-set, needs #2 weather-system handler

meteor-mash.name: Meteor Mash
meteor-mash.feel: A single steel punch fired like a meteor (count 1, pierce 0, BOTH cardLocked so cards can never multiply or pierce the primary). On contact it SHATTERS into a 3-projectile shrapnel fan radiating from the impact point (emit on enemyHit, 3 shots, spread 0.6, fast). The primary punch carries the 20% self atk-up (source stat_chance 20). Punch lands, bursts into shrapnel: the meteor-impact fantasy.
meteor-mash.flavor_text: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.

will-o-wisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
will-o-wisp.feel: 6s fire turret (anchor world, motion static, endOn [{ownerDeath},{time:6}]). The turret itself does NO direct damage (power 0); it EMITS a projectile on an interval that applies 100% burn (0 damage, pure burn delivery). A planted flame that keeps spitting burning wisps for 6 seconds. Matches the locked turret-emit worked example.
will-o-wisp.flavor_text: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.feel: Self-cast defensive cooldown (shapeless). Cast resolves immediately: pays 25% of max HP (recoil on cast) and raises a shield worth 2x the HP paid, regenerating at the shield's max HP/s for 6s. Incoming damage drains the shield first; overflow spills into real HP (overflow true). absorbsAll routes HP loss through the shield but does NOT block status; a status's damage-over-time drains the shield. With 100 max HP: pay 25, 50-HP shield, regen 50 HP/s, 6s. Formula values use the typed op/ref form, not JS strings. Matches the locked capped-regen-shield decision + schema worked example.
substitute.flavor_text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

aerial-ace.name: Aerial Ace
aerial-ace.feel: Teleport dash that does NOT return (repositionMode teleport, returnToOrigin false, so the caster ends at the target). 0.3s trailing i-frames from arrival (casterState iframes 0.3). On the strike: knockback + 50% confuse. Never-misses is flavor (no accuracy model needed). A blink-slash that leaves you where you struck. Pierce omitted (default UNLIMITED): the landing circle strikes everything inside it.
aerial-ace.flavor_text: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

flame-wheel.name: Flame Wheel
flame-wheel.feel: Simple fire trail (the locked trail/patch pattern): an emitter drops world-anchored fire patches along the caster's path as it moves (emit every 0.12s), each patch re-ticking damage + 10% burn while an enemy stands in it. Not a turret, not a charge. Damage move (power 60, unlike Toxic's status-only poison trail).
flame-wheel.flavor_text: The user attacks by cloaking itself in fire and charging at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

bubble-beam.name: Bubble Beam
bubble-beam.feel: Slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): a stream of 7 bubbles one after another on the aim line, about 25 px apart (Fairy Wind's emitter pattern: a still emitter at the caster fires a bubble every 0.075 s; 0.075 s x 330 px/s = 25 px). payload.note: doubles POWER (inside the attacker half) when the hop target has a major ailment (paralysis, freeze, sleep, burn, poison, toxic), checked per hop (slice 4b S8)
